2169-4694-7272-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-4694-7272-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

4210-4279-6026--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4210-4279-6026--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2023-3755-4770-6633.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-3967-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-3967-5632.description:
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Chalk Outline.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and Clue token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

907-997-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Selesnya Sanctuary.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Selesnya Sanctuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

533-5426-7839.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or artifact.
533-5426-7839.description:
Cast Insult by paying {2}{R}
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Insult

3512-4019-4221--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Living Plane, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Mana Flare triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
3512-4019-4221--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

338-3197-3263-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3197-3263-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

647-1409-3099-3755.description:

Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

4068-4289-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4068-4289-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1575-5903-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

628-2438-5007.description:

When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.
628-2438-5007.notes: The remaining -1/-1 counter can be removed each loop to gain infinite colored mana.

When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

206-3259-3263-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
206-3259-3263-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-3263-5953.description:

Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.

225-539-4518-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two permanent cards in your graveyard.
225-539-4518-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
When Kor Skyfisher enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping The Core.

1563-2837-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Repeat.

1012-5344-6349.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
1012-5344-6349.description:
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from the top of your library by paying {1}{W}.
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 7.

When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

Cryptic Trilobite triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.

4636-5391-5870.description:

When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart and Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

654-1479-2692-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-2692-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

116-1430-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Image on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Mirror Image do not have summoning sickness.
116-1430-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Mirror Image.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Mirror Image.
Activate Mirror Image by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Mirror Image ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

654-1170-2397-3389-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

791-3693-4522-5427.notablePrerequisites:
Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3693-4522-5427.description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it, doubling all damage dealt by sources you control this turn.
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3.

500-4867-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Rogue that cannot be blocked by an opponent and that does not have summoning sickness.
500-4867-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and creating a number of 1/1 Faerie Rogue creature tokens.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one Cormela token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the original Cormela and the token Cormela die, their abilities trigger, returning Time Warp and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

509-1267-1781-3933.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-1781-3933.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-1781-3933.description:
Activate Thran Forge by paying {2}, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact until end of turn and get +1/+0 until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

654-1018-1541-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Skullwinder on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Skullwinder's power.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Skullwinder from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating seven tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Skullwinder and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers seven times and Skullwinder triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand, and causing an opponent to return a card from their graveyard to their hand.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

Activate Moritte's second ability by tapping it, untapping Ioreth and another legendary creature you control.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Moritte and another legendary creature you control.

2047-2253-3263.description:
Cast Army of the Damned by paying {5}{B}{B}{B}, creating thirteen 2/2 Zombie creature tokens that are artifacts due to Mycosynth Lattice.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

1409-2366-2499-3470.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Dryad Arbor.
1409-2366-2499-3470.description:
Activate Dryad Arbor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Lotus Cobra twice.
Resolve both Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}{U}.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Dryad Arbor.
Repeat.

914-3368-5144.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3368-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Emphemerate.
Resolve the Emphemerate copy, blinking Dockside Extortionist, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate six Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding {R}{R} and four mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

122-2281-2438-2842-2890-4583-5237.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Protean Hulk to die.
122-2281-2438-2842-2890-4583-5237.description:
Get Protean Hulk killed, triggering its ability.
Get Phyrexian Delver and Carrion Feeder.
Phyrexian Delver ETB triggers, bring back Protean Hulk to play.
Sacrifice Protean Hulk to Carrion Feeder, triggering it's ability.
Get Body Snatcher and Blood Artist.
Body Snatcher ETB triggers, hold priority and sacrifice it to Carrion Feeder, triggering its death trigger.
Bring back Protean Hulk to play, Body Snatcher ETB resolves.
Sacrifice Protean Hulk to Carrion Feeder, triggering it's ability.
Get Renegade Rallier and Saffi Eriksdotter.
Use Saffi's ability, sacrificing itself, targeting Renegade Rallier.
Sacrifice Renegade Rallier to Carrion Feeder, triggering Blood Artist to ping an opponent.
Renegade Rallier returns to the battlefield from Saffi's delayed trigger.
Using Renegade Rallier's ETB ability, target Saffi and return Saffi to play.
Repeat.
